feature_selection.input_evidence: 2024 normalized price volatility shifts substantially; rank movement and top-quartile duration are more stable. Keep magnitude features. Lio/Haukeli positive-margin regimes differ.
feature_selection.error_evidence: Short1–12hour positive near-zero-margin interior blocks have worse AUC and greater wrong-pair concentration than longer blocks in both years. Lio has many errors away from transitions; no Lio cure claim.
feature_selection.limitations: Descriptive, composition-confounded findings, not proof of causal or predictive value; blocks are within-case proxies and censor flags identify horizon boundaries.
